title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook | 2-1/2-Inch Extension Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass | Classic Bath Accessory | Allied Brass
description:
Add hanging space exactly where you need it—then tuck it away. This traditional retractable wall hook is a space-saving choice for traditional bathroom hardware, giving you a convenient spot for towels, robes, or clothing while keeping the wall profile cleaner when not in use.

Highlights:
- Create instant hanging room: retractable rod extends to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space
- Keep walkways clear: retracts back to a 1" projection for a neater, lower-profile look
- Hold everyday items securely: rated to support up to 15 lb
- Coordinate with existing hardware: the supplied knob tip can be removed and replaced with a cabinet knob of your choice
- Built for standard walls: toggle mounting hardware is included for interior drywall

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
- Projection: 1"
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Installation requirements: drill one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around; all mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)
- Styling: traditional—ideal for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Finish variety: multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
